body:
Done. Rewrote all role prompt files with complete bundled content.

Files in `.thread/prompts/`:
- explorer.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + EXPLORER_RULES)
- builder.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + BUILDER_RULES)
- reviewer.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + REVIEWER_RULES)
- scout.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + SCOUT_RULES)
- designer.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + DESIGNER_RULES)
- tester.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + TESTER_RULES)
- bug-hunter.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES + BUG_HUNTER_RULES)
- worker.md (WORKER_BASE_RULES only)

Deleted: worker-2.md (unknown roles fall back to worker.md automatically).

Structure per file:
1. YAML frontmatter (`name`/`description`)
2. `### Direct User Message Forwarding` — verbatim rule from spec
3. `### Role: Worker` — WORKER_BASE_RULES from source
4. `### Subtype: <Role>` — matching subtype rules (omitted for worker.md)

Validation output confirms correct structure for explorer.md and builder.md.
